WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           p.SEX,
           AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(avg_ana) AS avg_ana
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       avg_acl_igg AS `average aCL IgG`,
       avg_ana AS `average ANA`,
       avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS `relative average ANA`
FROM sex_averages
